# chord-palette

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Chord colour token group: --chord-1…7 (one colour per Roman numeral's number, I … VII, ♭VII sharing VII's) and --chord-outside (a chord with no key). Its customizer section is the `customizer` child.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `ThemeEngine.TokenGroup` "Chord colours"
  - Uses: `ui/theme-engine.ThemeEngine`
- Core:
  - Uses: `ui/theme-engine.defineTokenGroup`
  - Exports (types): `ChordPaletteValues`
  - Exports (values): `chordPaletteGroup`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Tokens used by:
    - `apps/chord/piano`
    - `apps/chord/trainer`
    - `apps/sonata/chord-chart`
    - `apps/sonata/lyrics-hud`
    - `apps/sonata/progress/scrubber`
    - `apps/sonata/rich/chord-overlay`
    - `apps/sonata/rich/readout-keyboard`
    - `music/chord-box`
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/chord/shell`
    - `apps/sonata/shell`
    - `ui/tokens/chord-palette/customizer`
- Sub-plugins:
  - **`customizer`** — Customizer section for the chord colour token group (--chord-1…7, --chord-outside).
